name: claw-way-django rebuilt schema matches production (structural)
notes: Compares columns (name, type, length, nullability, default), index definitions and constraint names between a freshly-built database and production. THIS PLAN CURRENTLY FAILS with 39 differences — see README. It is kept failing on purpose: it is the evidence that a table-count check is not schema equivalence.

checks.proves: every table matches production in columns, indexes and constraints — not merely in name

does_not_prove: that data is equivalent — this compares structure only
that the production schema is itself correct, only that the rebuild matches it
that application behaviour is identical; a matching schema can still hold wrong data
